digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler differ and production snapshot call site
propositions: The raw differ emits field_drift as a positive control when given mismatched local and remote state, but the production snapshot call site must suppress these emissions because it incorrectly passes two remote states instead of true local state.
Suppressing field_drift and unbound_local at the production call site does not prevent genuine inbound-create mutations or invariant repairs from being planned and executed.
A converged reconciliation pass with a key-set previous snapshot records zero mutations and produces no mutational side effects, proving the filter is load-bearing and correct.
The production differ call path is instrumented to emit zero per-mutation git operations when processing snapshot pairs, and this zero count is validated by a live counter positive control.

Modifying the raw differ to emit both paths would break the positive control and contradict the deliberate architectural decision to filter at the call site, preserving the ability to migrate to real local state in the future.
